note: Tracks retagging progress against the 100-tag taxonomy (v3). main_next_index / artiflix_next_index is the array index in data/movies.json / data/artiflix-movies.json to resume from. Movies before that index in the current pass have been reviewed against all 100 tags (their existing tags kept, new ones added where applicable — absence of a new tag means it was considered and didn't apply, not that it was skipped).
